Happy Hour Hours Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday: 5:00 PM - 6:30 PM Friday and Saturday: dinner service only, from 5:00 PM Monday: closed Also Happening Martini Wednesdays - $12 martinis, 7:00 to 9:00 PM Weekend Brunch - Saturday and Sunday with $25 bottomless mimosas Where to Find Us Port Union, 1559 N Milwaukee Ave, Chicago, IL 60622 . In Wicker Park at the crossroads of Bucktown, steps from the Damen Blue Line. Call (312) 363-3110 or reserve on Resy or Yelp. Happy Hour FAQ What days is happy hour at Port Union? Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, from 5:00 to 6:30 PM. There is no happy hour on Friday or Saturday, and we are closed Mondays. Do I need a reservation for happy hour? No. Walk-ins are welcome at the bar and high-tops. You can also reserve a table on Resy if you prefer. Where is happy hour served? At the bar, the high-tops and in the dining room - the full room, not just the bar. How much are the oysters? One dollar each with any beverage purchase, dine-in only, during happy hour. Are there vegetarian options at happy hour? Yes. The turnip causa and the pan de ajo are both vegetarian, and the turnip causa is fully plant-based. Is there happy hour on the weekend? Sunday, yes - 5:00 to 6:30 PM. Friday and Saturday are regular dinner service, with the full menu from 5 PM.

Features a patio and full cocktail program with Greek-inspired drinks.

terms: Gaijin happy hour runs Tuesday through Thursday from 5:00pm to 6:00pm. The venue features deals on both food and drinks during happy hour, including cocktail specials. Gaijin by Chef Paul Virant is Chicago's first and only dedicated okonomiyaki and kakigori restaurant, specializing in Hiroshima and Osaka style savory Japanese pancakes. The bar program showcases highballs and a focused selection of beer including a Moody Tongue-Gaijin collaboration house lager, sake, Japanese whisky, and wine. Located in West Loop/Fulton Market at 950 W Lake St. The venue has a patio and offers a lively interactive culinary experience with a custom 12-foot griddle and individual Hiroshima teppan griddles for table service.

terms: Daisies happy hour runs Wednesday through Friday from 3:00pm to 5:00pm at their Logan Square location. This Midwest Italian restaurant offers an extensive happy hour menu featuring $5 draft beers and cans including Moody Tongue Aperitif Pilsner, Pipeworks x Daisies Rye Ale, Hopewell Lightbeam Hazy IPA, and Eris Blush Cider. Cocktails are $7 and include the Blossom (whiskey, aronia, elderflower, soda), Beet Manhattan (buffalo trace bourbon, beets, dill, dry marsala, pasubio), Physician's Highball (alpine liqueurs, blanc vermouth, herb soda), and Paloma Rubia (mommenpop grapefruit, suze, oleo, soda). Wine selection includes sparkling wines at $7, white wines ranging from $7-$9, orange/rosé wines at $7-$9, and red wines at $7-$9. Food offerings include snacks like Gnocco Fritto for $5, Onion Dip with house made ruffles for $8, Simple Green Salad for $13, and Fritto Misto for $12. An extensive tinned seafood selection is available featuring El Capricho, Conservas de Cambados, Real Conservas, and Fangst brands with various preparations ranging from $12-$38, plus caviar supplements from $11-$90.
